_about: Which strings of the page list (/api/spec) are display text. One list, read by localizeSpec (index.ts) and by mzdesk/spec_i18n.py, so the two cannot drift. A kind is a node of the spec tree; 'root' names the kind of each top-level list. text: keys whose string (or list of strings) is translated in place. keyed: keys holding an object whose KEYS are column names and whose values are help text (both are translated; the English key is kept too, because a table that gets its columns from a run still looks up by the English name). children: keys holding a list of nodes of another kind. lookup: strings the code also uses as a lookup key, a value or in a comparison (section titles group and compare; a cards item label is the key into the run's values; the options of a select / radio / multiselect are the values sent to the server), so localizeSpec leaves them alone: they are in the translation list, and the component that draws one calls t() on it. context: {block id: {English text: context}} for a string that means something else in that block than everywhere else; the dictionary entry of it is 'text|context' (a language without it falls back to the plain text), and a block id here must be one block of one page (tests/test_i18n.py). Never listed: ids, types, field values, example inputs, adducts, ion_modes, visible_when and other comparisons, flags, numbers, cls, based_on (engine and database names), stages (their titles come back from the run).
